known_findings.summary: KDS plotting/report APIs expose pos_label/class_index but do not forward them to decile_table; report also passes digits as ignored round_decimal, so caller selections/precision can be silently ignored.
Legacy modelplotpy.ModelPlotPy.prepare_scores_and_ntiles calls np.random.seed(self.seed), mutating process-global NumPy RNG state as an incidental side effect.
